references.text: The same procedure of laying a covering of tachash skins over and putting the poles in place is used for the ark of the covenant
A similar procedure with a tachash-skin covering and carrying poles is used for the table of showbread
The same pattern with a tachash-skin covering and carrying pole is used for the gold altar and the holy utensils
Tachash skins are mentioned as material for the tabernacle
Tachash skins are used as a covering over the tabernacle
The Kohathites carried the holy things on poles, not on carts, because they were their responsibility
